messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: model builds are broken
parts:
In addition to killing the unit tests, Matt's
refactoring of the matrix libs declare/define
structure has also broken the way I documented
model building.

As of now, the linker's failing:

---------------------
~/stan>clang++ -O0 -I src -I lib anon_model.cpp
Undefined symbols:
"__ZN4stan5agrad10var_stack_E", referenced from:
__ZN4stan5agrad14recover_memoryEv in cc-YhB0fh.o
__ZN4stan5agrad4gradEPNS0_9chainableE in cc-YhB0fh.o
__ZN4stan5agrad4variC2Ed in cc-YhB0fh.o
"__ZN4stan5agrad9memalloc_E", referenced from:
__ZN4stan5agrad14recover_memoryEv in cc-YhB0fh.o
__ZN4stan5agrad9chainablenwEm in cc-YhB0fh.o
ld: symbol(s) not found
clang: error: linker command failed with exit code 1 (use -v to see invocation)
-------------------

I'd like to doc the way to build a simple
model w/o a makefile, which before the change
looked like the above.

What should I be doing instead now?

I don't think we can have it both ways here, as the
generated model code is going to have to decide
how to do its includes.

- Bob

messages.author: 1004dd6f66bb10c3
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] model builds are broken
parts:
You need to add the flags
-Lbin -lstan
to the linker call (assuming that libstan.a has been built by saying
"make bin/libstan.a"). This tells the linker to link against the stan
library. In the makefile, those flags are in the LDFLAGS variable.

If you don't want to use a makefile at all, you can build libstan.a by
hand like so:
g++ -I src -I lib -O3 -g -c -o src/stan/agrad/agrad.o src/stan/agrad/agrad.cpp
g++ -I src -I lib -O3 -g -c -o src/stan/math/matrix.o src/stan/math/matrix.cpp
g++ -I src -I lib -O3 -g -c -o src/stan/agrad/matrix.o src/stan/agrad/matrix.cpp
ar -rs bin/libstan.a src/stan/agrad/agrad.o src/stan/math/matrix.o
src/stan/agrad/matrix.o

Matt

between archives (.a) and object files (.o)? I
didn't see either one with "clang++ --help" or "g++ --help".

> to the linker call (assuming that libstan.a has been built by saying

I just wanted to understand the steps without
having to reverse engineer them from the makefiles,
which I find very confusing.

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] model builds are broken
parts:
Not sure where this is, but I found one issue with the build setup right now.  At least on Linux, you need to put the -Lbin -lstan after the .cpp file for it to recognize the symbols therein.  This was breaking unit tests and model building for me.

I can push my fix for it if needed.

Cheers,
Marcus
